declared_exclusions.reason: deck_generation/.gitignore lines 14-15 ignore brand_spec/ and brand/, so neither exists in any worktree; the copies were taken from the primary checkout by absolute path and the source cannot be read by any test that runs in a worktree. Recorded as IRPT_FNTEND-W2-S1.

surprises: IRPT_FNTEND-W2-S1: the two brand sources the order names -- deck_generation/brand_spec/brand.json and the logo package SVG -- are gitignored (deck_generation/.gitignore:14-15) and therefore absent from every worktree; tokens and logo were copied into the package from the primary checkout by absolute path.

IRPT_FNTEND-W2-S2: the FE-s-1 ExportBundle contract carries no reportKind, no report payloads, no beginning/ending value and no disclosure text, so the package defines an additive RenderBundle over it -- a backend that implements export-preview to the contract as written will be refused by the print entry rather than rendered.

IRPT_FNTEND-W2-S3: no Lato binary exists anywhere reachable and obtaining one is egress off Opal infrastructure, so the packaged fonts could not be packaged; print.css declares each face with local() first and the fallback stack carries the document, which is also what both acceptance PNGs show.

IRPT_FNTEND-W2-S4: recharts 3.7.0 renders an empty wrapper (127 bytes, no SVG) under renderToStaticMarkup, so a server-side render without a browser layout would emit a chartless report; the endpoint labels and the full series table are real DOM so every plotted value survives in both planes.

IRPT_FNTEND-W2-S5: portal/scripts/ui-smoke.mjs compares window.location.pathname against the full route argument, so every query-carrying route prints 'DID NOT LAND' while landing correctly -- both F4-AC7 and F4-AC8 print it at rc=0.
